================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO BAKENG SA AFTER EFFECTS - LINTHO TSE NCHA
Phatlalatso 9.2.9  -  Mphalane 2026
================================================================================

LI-THEME TSA ANIME tse ncha tse 33 li eketsoa ho tsa Demon Slayer, liphello tsa mouse tsa
li-theme joale li hlaha ka 'nete ka hare ho After Effects, 'me Mokhethi oa Theme joale ke
lethathamo le le leng le theohang le hlophisehileng.

PELE U QALA
- Kenya holim'a phatlalatso ea hau ea hajoale ka ZXP installer ea hau e tloaelehileng, ebe u
  qala After Effects hape hang.
- Litlhophiso tsa hau, theme, li-preset le li-expression tse bolokiloeng lia bolokoa.

E NCHA: LI-THEME TSA ANIME TSE 33
- Litlhophiso tsa Flex > MOKHETHI OA THEME > THEME EA PANEL joale e na le sehlopha se le
  seng bakeng sa anime ka 'ngoe:
  Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta), Bleach (Ichigo,
  Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch), Dandadan
  (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren, Fullmetal
  Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka), Jujutsu
  Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob), My Hero
  Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto (Itachi, Minato), One Piece
  (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero (Rem), Solo Leveling
  (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) le Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- Sebapali se seng le se seng se na le chebahalo ea sona: se latelang mouse ea hau, tlhaselo
  ha u tobetsa button, se etsahalang ha u ntse u tšoere button e ka letsohong le letšehali, le
  ho phatloha ka mor'a ho e tšoara metsotsoana e ka bang 2.5.
- Li bobebe joalo ka li-theme tsa Demon Slayer: liphello li sebetsa feela ha u tsamaisa mouse
  kapa u tobetsa. Tima LIPHELLO TSA TIKOLOHO ho boloka mebala feela.

E FETOHILE: MOKHETHI OA THEME
- Likarete tsa Demon Slayer tlas'a THEME EA PANEL li tlositsoe, kahoo Litlhophiso tsa Flex li
  khutšoanyane. Khetha theme e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe lethathamong le theohang la THEME EA PANEL;
  le bula ho theme eo u e sebelisang.
- Kurama le Baryon joale ba sehlopheng sa Naruto.

E LOKISITSOE
- Liphello tsa mouse tsa li-theme (metsi, malakabe, lehalima le tse ling) hangata li ne li sa
  hlahe ka hare ho After Effects, leha Mokhoa o Ntlafalitsoeng o ne o timiloe. Linako tseo
  panele ka boeona e phathahaneng, le ho qala ho phathahaneng, li ne li nkoa e le ho lieha ha
  theme, kahoo liphello li ne li itima. Joale, ha karete ea hau ea litšoantšo e li taka
  (likhomphutha tse ngata), linako tseo li etsa feela hore liphello li be bobebe nakoana.

TSE SA FETOHANG
- Laesense, ho kenya tšebetsong le link e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe li sebetsa ka tsela e tšoanang le pele.
- Li-theme tse 11 tsa Demon Slayer li shebahala ka tsela e tšoanang le ho 9.2.8.
- Li-tab tse ling tsohle le lisebelisoa li sebetsa ka tsela e tšoanang le ho 9.2.8.
================================================================================

- Lethathamo le theohang la THEME EA PANEL le ne le ka tsoela pele ho bontša lebitso la theme
